rules.description: Cache public pages for signed-out visitors. The app decides what and for how long: no Cache-Control means no caching.
rules.expression: http.host eq "discobiscuits.net" and not http.cookie contains "-auth-token" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/shows/year/") and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/_root.data" "/about" "/about.data" "/terms" "/terms.data" "/privacy" "/privacy.data" "/community" "/community.data" "/mcp-info" "/mcp-info.data" "/calibrated-rating-algorithm" "/calibrated-rating-algorithm.data"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/songs") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/shows") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/venues") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/musicians") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/authors") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/resources") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/blog"))
